q2_gaps: "during" + a bare-plural period noun ("during molting weeks"): the During rule specifies (During <inner> <outer>) with both arguments reified eventualities, and gives no form for a period-denoting NP as the outer argument — the parse uses the bare kind symbol molting_week, which is neither a witness nor a calendar/deictic Time term
notes: Group-only encoding of transitive "gather" (no per-member rule) is licensed because the instruction set names gather in its collective-predicate list, though the transitive collecting sense arguably distributes. Everything else — Possession on the possessed group, the distributive (PartOf $x .. -> fallen) rule at 1.0 0.9, Time morning + Every 1 day, and the noun-modifier-suppressed molting_week genus — follows the stated rules.
